messages:
nina: Hey team — need a quick cover swap for oncall this Sunday (local) afternoon. I have a flight delay; can someone take 13:00–17:00 PST (21:00–01:00 UTC)? I can cover up to 15:00 PST then need to head to the airport. I'll leave a handoff + runbook link. Sorry for the short notice :pray:

mika: I can pick up 13:00–15:00 PST (21:00–23:00 UTC). Happy to take final handoff at 14:45 and monitor canaries. :+1:

sam: I can do 15:00–17:00 PST (23:00–01:00 UTC). Will need the prewarm step though.

lee: I can shadow from 13:00–14:00 PST and do the pass to mika. Leaving my calendar free.

nina: Thanks! Putting runbook + quick prewarm below. Main risk: small model rollout scheduled Sunday 22:30 UTC — if rollout starts while coverage changes, revert plan is in runbook.

nina: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-general (perm: eng-oncall)

nina: Prewarm steps (devbox):
```bash
# warm KV cache for 'redwood-prod' service
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/prewarm"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN"
  -d '{"service":"redwood-prod","model":"gptq-3b","samples":50}'
# quick health check
curl -sS https://api.redwood.internal/health | jq .
```

mika: Got it. Any special flags? batching/quantization?

nina: Use flag --use-kv-cache for the prewarm call if you want to populate prefix cache; otherwise default is fine. Also see the 'safe-fallback' label on models; if the primary is busy, route to cpu-fallback automatically.

sam: Noted. I'll be online on my phone in case of pages. Ping me in thread for handoff confirmation.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window 2026-03-22 22:30-23:10 UTC (model rollout).

lee: One more thing — if error 502 appears on /generate, try clearing the nginx upstreams with:
```bash
kubectl rollout restart deploy/nginx-proxy -n infra
```

nina: Thanks all. Confirming: mika covers 13–15, sam covers 15–17, lee shadows 13–14. I'll leave my laptop logged in and post final handoff at 14:45 PST. :airplane: :white_check_mark:

mika: confirmed, will post a short handoff message at 14:45 PST with cache status.

sam: confirmed. I'll take the pager at 15:00 and run prewarm at 14:50.
